items.name: New Zealand Nationals 2025

venue.name: Auckland Netball Centre
venue.address: 7 Allison Ferguson Drive, St Johns, Auckland 1072

items.information:
New Zealand Nationals 2025 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition.

This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary.

Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

items.information:
**Te invitamos al torneo más importante del año!**
Recordá que para participar es obligatorio estar familiarizado con el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)

¡Te necesitamos para seguir fortaleciendo nuestra comunidad! Involucrate con las diferentes tareas que nos ayudan a un torneo exitoso y agradable para todos, ya sea como juez, runner, scrambler, etc. Te dejamos links para más información a continuación:

*[Reglas basicas sobre cómo competir](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8O_iWRGq4K8)
*[Manual WCA para competidores](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/es/tutorial.pdf)
*[Manual WCA para jueces](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/judge-tutorial/judge-tutorial-es.pdf)

Te esperamos :)

**Be part of the greatest competition of the year!**
Remember that to participate it is mandatory to be familiar with the "[WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/)"

We need you to continue strengthening our community! Get involved with the different tasks that help us to have a successful and enjoyable tournament for everyone, be it as a judge, runner, scrambler, etc. We leave you links for more information below:

*[Basics rules to compete](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww)
*[WCA competitor tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf)
*[WCA judging tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/judge-tutorial/judge-tutorial.pdf)

See you there :)
